title: Embedded Engineer | SNDK CORP
description:
Full Time

Ahmedabad

**Job Summary:**
----------------

We are looking for an Embedded Engineer with **2–3 years of experience in embedded systems, IoT communication, and PCB design.** The candidate will be responsible for **firmware development, hardware interfacing, and PCB design using Altium Designer**, along with implementation of **Zigbee-based wireless communication systems.**

**Experience:** 2-3 years

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Develop **embedded firmware in C/C++** for microcontrollers.
* Work with microcontrollers such as **ESP32, STM32, ARM Cortex, PIC.**
* Interface peripherals like **UART, SPI, I2C, ADC, DAC, PWM, GPIO.**
* Implement wireless communication protocols such as **WiFi, BLE, MQTT, and Zigbee.**
* Work with **Zigbee Coordinator / Router / End Device** configurations in Zigbee networks.
* Configure and develop applications using **Zigbee2MQTT or other Zigbee controller platforms.**
* Design and modify **PCB layouts using Altium Designer.**
* Perform **component placement, routing, and DRC checks.**
* Generate **Gerber files, BOM, and manufacturing outputs.**
* Support **board bring-up, testing, and product validation.**

**Required Skills:**
--------------------

* Strong programming in **Embedded C / C++**
* Experience with **ESP32 / ARM microcontrollers**
* Knowledge of **UART, SPI, I2C communication protocols**
* Experience with **IoT protocols like MQTT and WiFi**
* Hands-on experience with **Zigbee networks and controllers**
* Hands-on **PCB design using Altium Designer**
* Understanding of **hardware schematics and PCB layouts**
* Experience in **2-layer / 4-layer PCB design**
* Knowledge of **high-voltage PCB design (e.g., 230V track clearance)**

If you are a skilled Embedded Hardware Engineer looking for a challenging and rewarding career, please submit your application today.

title: Service Technician
description:
**Job description:**

**Company :** KNI Services Pvt. Ltd. (Kitchen Network International)

**Job Title:** Service Engineer

**Department:** Technical Services & Operations

**Location:** nikol, Ahmedabad, Gujarat

**Experience:** 1–5 years

**Employment Type:** Full-time

**Reporting To:** Founder & CEO

**About KNI**

KNI Services Pvt. Ltd. (Kitchen Network International) is building India's largest technology-driven service network for Commercial Kitchen Equipment. We provide installation, preventive maintenance, breakdown support, AMC management, technical training, and certified service engineers through the KNI platform across India.

**Position Overview**

We are looking for a skilled and customer-focused Service Engineer to provide installation, commissioning, troubleshooting, repair, maintenance, and technical support for company equipment and systems. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring equipment operates efficiently and reliably while maintaining high levels of customer satisfaction.

The ideal candidate should have 10+ years of experience in servicing commercial kitchen equipment and should be capable of troubleshooting complex technical issues both remotely and on-site.

**Key Responsibilities**

Install, commission, inspect, and maintain equipment at customer locations.

Diagnose and troubleshoot electrical, mechanical, electronic, and control-system issues.

Attend customer complaints and provide timely technical support.

Carry out preventive and corrective maintenance activities.

Perform equipment testing and ensure proper functioning after service.

Prepare service reports, maintenance reports, and technical documentation.

Coordinate with customers regarding service schedules and technical requirements.

Identify recurring equipment problems and recommend corrective actions.

Provide technical guidance and basic training to customers/operators.

Maintain service records, spare-parts requirements, and equipment history.

Coordinate with the sales, production, engineering, and spare-parts teams when required.

Follow company safety procedures and customer-site safety requirements.

Travel to customer locations for installation, breakdown, and maintenance work.

**Must possess strong knowledge of:**

Combi Ovens

Conveyor Ovens

Deck Ovens

Rotary Rack Ovens

Coffee Machines (Automatic & Semi-Automatic)

Dishwashers (Hood Type, Rack Conveyor & Flight Type)

Ice Cube Machines

Blast Chillers & Blast Freezers

Walk-in Cold Rooms

Reach-in Refrigerators & Freezers

Under Counter Refrigeration

Planetary Mixers

Spiral Mixers

Dough Kneaders

Dough Sheeters

Bakery Equipment

Tilting Bratt Pans

Steam Jacketed Kettles

Fryers

Griddles

Charbroilers

Salamanders

Gas Ranges

Induction Cooking Equipment

Pasta Cookers

Bain Marie

Hot Holding Equipment

Vacuum Packing Machines

Vegetable Preparation Machines

Meat Processing Equipment

Food Processors

Slicers

Imported Refrigeration Systems

HVAC systems related to commercial kitchens

Kitchen Ventilation & Exhaust Systems

Electrical Control Panels

PLC-based Kitchen Equipment

Steam Systems

Gas Pipeline Systems

Water Treatment Systems connected with dishwashers and combi ovens

**Required Skills:**

1–5 years of relevant experience in service, maintenance, installation, or commissioning.

Good troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

Ability to read technical drawings, electrical diagrams, and equipment manuals.

Basic knowledge of electrical/mechanical tools and measuring instruments.

Good communication and customer-handling skills.

Willingness to travel to customer sites as required.

Valid driving license may be required depending on the job location.

**Preferred Skills :**

Preventive and breakdown maintenance experience.

Knowledge of PLC, sensors, motors, drives, control panels, or automation systems, depending on the equipment.

Good computer skills and ability to prepare service reports.

Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

Ability to work independently as well as with a team.

Customer-oriented approach and professional attitude.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) :**

Response time to customer service calls.

First-time resolution rate.

Equipment uptime and service quality.

Preventive maintenance completion.

Customer satisfaction.

Service report accuracy and timely submission.

Reduction in repeat breakdowns.

**Why Join KNI? :**

Lead India's growing commercial kitchen service network.

Build and mentor a nationwide team of certified engineers.

Work with premium imported commercial kitchen equipment.

Opportunity to shape KNI's technical training academy and service standards.

Be part of a fast-growing technology-driven service ecosystem transforming the HORECA industry.

**Email:** info@kniservices.com

**Mobile:** +91 80017 00002

**Website:** www.kniservices.com

Health insurance

title: BIT Support Engineer
description:
**Job Title: BIT Support Engineer** 

**Location: Ahmedabad**

**Experience: 5–10 Years**

**Employment Type: Full\-Time** 

Role Overview

We are looking for a skilled BIT Support Engineer (L2/L3\) to manage and support our enterprise IT infrastructure, networks, and cloud environments. The role involves handling critical incidents, ensuring high system availability, and acting as an escalation point for complex technical issues in a 24x7 operational setup.

Key Responsibilities

* Monitor and manage IT infrastructure using 24x7 monitoring tools
* Act as L2/L3 escalation point for complex incidents (P1/P2\) and perform root cause analysis (RCA)
* Administer and support Windows/Linux servers and enterprise applications
* Configure and manage network devices (routers, switches, firewalls, VPNs)
* Manage Next\-Generation Firewalls (NGFW) including policies, failover, and performance tuning
* Support data center operations including servers, SAN storage, and virtualization platforms
* Administer VMware/ESXi environments (VM provisioning, snapshots, cluster health)
* Manage and support cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Handle Microsoft 365 ecosystem (Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, Azure AD, MFA)
* Ensure infrastructure security using antivirus, EDR tools, and security best practices
* Lead or support IT infrastructure projects (migrations, upgrades, deployments)
* Maintain SOPs, documentation, DR plans, and knowledge base
* Coordinate with vendors/TAMs for issue resolution and hardware/software support
* Mentor and guide junior engineers and improve team performance
* Ensure compliance with IT security standards and regulatory requirements

Required Skills \& Expertise

Technical Skills

* Strong experience in L2/L3 Support \& Incident Management (ITIL framework)
* Hands\-on experience with:
* Windows Server \& Linux (RHEL/Ubuntu)
* Networking (LAN/WAN, VPN, Routers, Switches)
* Firewalls (NGFW – Palo Alto, Fortinet, etc.)
* Virtualization (VMware/ESXi)
* Cloud Platforms (AWS / Azure / GCP)
* Microsoft 365 (Exchange, SharePoint, Azure AD)
* Knowledge of SAN Storage \& Data Center operations
* Familiarity with security tools (EDR, Antivirus) and compliance standards (ISO, PCI, GDPR)

Educational Qualification

* Bachelor’s Degree / Diploma in IT, Electronics, or related field
* Relevant certifications preferred:
* CCNA / CCNP
* Microsoft Certified
* AWS / Azure / Cloud certifications

Soft Skills

* Strong analytical and troubleshooting abilities
* Ability to handle high\-pressure situations (critical outages)
* Good communication \& stakeholder management skills
* Ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines
* Team player with mentoring capabilities

**Note that the candidate would be required to work in rotational shift(morning, night and general).**

Work Location: In person
